# A17-S20: Exhibition plan

Correspondence extract. [████] marks redaction; […] marks omission.

[…]

Thanks for the chat the day before yesterday, it was super cozy. I still like the idea of a workstation with an iPad, which could be connected to the different social media accounts and blogs I've created. It can provide a good exhibition space together with the screen in the foyer. Do you have such a tablet lying around, possibly with a case so it can stand up, and maybe a discreet, smaller office table?

I also have a couple of practical questions:
- Who should I send the invoice to - you or the accounting department? And roughly when should it be sent, if a payment should reach the last business day of the month?

- Here is a link to an exhibition in Copenhagen. In post-corona confusion, they have set it up as an online event, but there is now an opening today at 17 - just in case you find time :-) 
[link omitted]

It has gone quite well with data collection, so I'm gradually ready with some very simple and somewhat fun beta versions of how an AI thinks it is to go into politics ;-)

Talk soon, best regards [████]
